result_summary: Vimeo/media readiness is complete through local contracts and safe preview smoke. The lane implements an exact Vimeo readiness state model, redacted token/capability checks, private-by-default TUS upload construction, mock upload/progress/retry/duplicate/metadata/folder behavior, manual URL attachment readiness, playback/member entitlement checks, class-session/transcript linkage, and a private synthetic smoke command. No real Vimeo upload, publish/unpublish/delete, member visibility change, notification, production mutation, or deployment was performed.
requirements_closed: Token capability and permission checks with redacted output
Private/unlisted upload request defaults and no-public-publish guard
Mockable upload flow with progress, retry, duplicate protection, metadata update, and folder attach
Manual Vimeo URL attachment and approval-gated library state
Workspace/provider ownership and member entitlement checks
Class-session and transcript linkage payload plus redacted audit event
Private synthetic smoke command with safe preview-only skip when not configured
Vimeo setup/readiness docs and media pipeline matrix

private_smoke.reason: BNA_VIMEO_PRIVATE_SMOKE=1 and approved token/account/project/synthetic asset were not configured in this environment.

shared_patch.summary: No shared route/UI patch was applied or requested by this lane. Route/UI integration remains final-integrator work if needed.

blockers.summary: A real private synthetic Vimeo upload requires approved Vimeo test account/token/folder and a generated non-sensitive synthetic asset.
blockers.next_action: Configure VIMEO_ACCESS_TOKEN, BNA_VIMEO_TEST_ACCOUNT_CONFIRMED=true, expected account, test project/folder, BNA_VIMEO_SYNTHETIC_TEST_FILE, and BNA_VIMEO_PRIVATE_SMOKE=1 only after account ownership and target are confirmed.
